objectives.note:
0.5 League Runes of Aldur: Farrow was introduced back in Act 1 — there is no Runic Alloy quest here at the Caravan. Instead, every zone holds an Ezomyte Remnant (inscribe runes → fight waves → claim a reward), and certain zones hold a Runestone that summons Farrow and unlocks new recipes. The Act 2 Runic Vault chain is reached via Deshar (see below).
Runeforging ladder One tier unlocks per act: Act 1 Armour Runeforging → Act 2 Runic Inscriptions → Act 3 Unique Runeforging → Act 4 Ancient Runes.
